question: Q022: how is the heart's electrical activity coupled to force when perfusion changes? Paired electrical, mechanical and perfusion data are required.

model_constrained.note: 0-D lumped: it has NO anatomical geometry, so 3-D anatomical imaging datasets constrain no parameter of this version. They are listed only for a future distributed successor.

access_classes.OPEN_NO_REQUEST: downloads work anonymously, verified in this job
access_classes.OPEN_WITH_REQUEST: open licence but a data use agreement or a request form is required, not verified in this job

datasets.name: PTB-XL, a large publicly available electrocardiography dataset, version 1.0.3
datasets.format: WFDB .dat/.hea, 12 leads, 16-bit, resolution 1 uV/LSB, 500 Hz (100 Hz mirror), 10 s per record; metadata in ptbxl_database.csv with SCP-ECG statements
datasets.subjects: 21869 records from 18869 patients (51% male); median age 62 y
datasets.measured_modality: surface 12-lead ECG, Einthoven/Goldberger frame, right-arm reference
constrains: electrical_sigma (model drive FWHM 0.0589 s vs measured QRS duration)
electrical_center (R-peak placement of the drive relative to force)
k_on, k_off (rise/decay of the activation gate against measured QRS upstroke)
beat window: model integrates a fixed 1.0 s episode while the measured median RR is 0.652 s in record 00001

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV Waveform Database version 0.1.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0
datasets.format: WFDB per-signal-group .hea + FLAC-compressed .dat payloads (magic 'fLaC'), counter-based timing (e.g. 62.4725/999.56(5120) = 3200 samples at 624.725 Hz), ADC gain/zero/resolution per signal, groups suffixed e=ECG, p=pleth/pressure, r=impedance respiration
datasets.subjects: UNKNOWN_NOT_FETCHED: subject-level count not parsed within the 45 min budget; the release is organised per ICU stay and per waveform segment
datasets.measured_modality: ECG leads (II, V, aVR, I, III), Pleth, impedance Resp, and ABP/Art/CVP in other stays, all on one time base per segment
constrains: k_on, k_off: measured R-peak to Pleth/ABP upstroke delay tests the model's electrical_to_activation_lag_s window [0, 0.080] s
afterload: ABP amplitude and dP/dt as the real load the model's 0.10 normalised afterload stands in for
passive_stiffness, damping, length_width: beat-to-beat strain amplitude from Pleth/ABP pulse amplitude
time base: counter-tick timestamps let a multi-beat electrical drive be aligned to pressure
datasets.downloaded_in_this_job: yes: samples/mimic4wdb_p10014354/ record 81739927 segment 0002 (5.12 s, ECG II/V/aVR + Pleth + Resp)
datasets.blocker: FLAC payloads need a decoder; this container has no wfdb, no soundfile and no pip. Header form verified at byte level, sample values UNKNOWN.

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV-ECG: Diagnostic Electrocardiogram Matched Subset version 1.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0
datasets.format: WFDB 12-lead 10 s diagnostic ECG, machine-generated statements plus findings text, matched by stay to MIMIC-IV clinical and waveform tables
datasets.measured_modality: surface 12-lead ECG linked to invasive pressure, labs and diagnoses for the same ICU stay
constrains: ca_ec50, hill_n, gregg_gain: the cohort link lets ECG morphology (ischaemia, LBBB, MI) be tested against the pressure and outcome columns for the same patient
electrical_sigma: QRS duration as a population statistic with SCP-QRS codes, not from one record
hypoxia_penalty: ischaemic diagnoses in the matched clinical table

datasets.name: HeartCycle: synchronized impedance cardiography and echocardiography, version 1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
datasets.format: synchronized ICG (dZ/dt), echocardiography video, ECG and further modalities; the release states it is the first open dataset with simultaneous ICG, ECHO and ECG
datasets.measured_modality: electrical (ECG) + thoracic impedance mechanical (ICG) + echocardiographic wall motion, all time-synchronised
constrains: length_width, velocity_half, compression_coef: measured LV wall excursion and thickening from echo vs strain
passive_stiffness, damping, afterload: ICG dZ/dt B and X points vs systolic time intervals
k_on, k_off: ECG-R to ICG-B lag, an independent check of the activation gate timing

datasets.name: SCG-RHC: Wearable Seismocardiogram Signal and Right Heart Catheter Database, version 1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
datasets.format: wearable seismocardiogram plus simultaneous right heart catheter haemodynamics; the release states the goal is to track PAP and pulmonary capillary wedge pressure from the SCG signal
datasets.measured_modality: chest-wall mechanical vibration + invasive right-sided pressures (ECG-synchronised in the release)
constrains: p_ext, p_ref, flow_max: the only open dataset found with an invasive pressure target tied to a chest-wall mechanical signal
afterload, passive_stiffness: SCG peak timing and amplitude against catheter pressures
gregg_gain, hypoxia_penalty: the closest open proxy for the perfusion-to-force route, but right-sided, not coronary

datasets.name: SensSmartTech database of cardiovascular signals, version 1.0.0
datasets.format: polycardiograph: PCG 1 kHz, ECG, PPG, accelerometer, bioimpedance, synchronised; heart rate deliberately spans 58-173 bpm
datasets.measured_modality: electrical (ECG) + mechanical (PCG chest vibration, accelerometer) + arterial pulse (PPG) on one clock
constrains: electrical_center, k_on, k_off: S1 timing relative to R across a 58-173 bpm sweep, i.e. rate dependence the fixed model cannot express
tau_ca, tau_load, length_width, velocity_half: relaxation dynamics across heart rates
velocity_half: PPG upstroke time as a mechanical analogue of the model's force-velocity term

datasets.name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database version 1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
datasets.format: WFDB 2-lead (MLII, V5) 12-bit, 360 Hz, 30 min per record, with beat and rhythm annotations
datasets.subjects: UNKNOWN_NOT_FETCHED (the classic 48 records / 22 subjects figure was NOT re-read in this job)
datasets.measured_modality: surface 2-lead ECG with beat annotation files
constrains: k_on, k_off, electrical_sigma: annotation-driven QRS onset/offset instead of a threshold estimator, at 360 Hz
beat window: annotated RR intervals, the distribution the model's single 1.0 s episode has to generalise over

datasets.name: Myocardial Perfusion Scintigraphy image database, version 1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0
datasets.format: nuclear medicine images, rest and stress, LV wall delineation; the whole release is 50.4 MB so a study fits the 50 MiB bound
datasets.measured_modality: in-vivo myocardial perfusion, tracer uptake, not time-resolved and not pressure
constrains: gregg_gain, perfusion_gamma, hypoxia_penalty: only as a binary rest-vs-stress ischaemia label, so it can test the SIGN of the perfusion-force route and nothing about its magnitude
datasets.verdict: WEAK_FOR_THIS_MODEL: no time base, no pressure, no beat resolution

datasets.name: Epicardially attached cardiac accelerometer data from canines and porcines, version 1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
datasets.format: accelerometer on a temporary epicardial pacing lead, direct measurement of heart motion
datasets.subjects: UNKNOWN_NOT_FETCHED; species are canines and porcines, not human
constrains: length_width, velocity_half, compression_coef, damping: direct myocardial motion is the cleanest available handle on the strain terms

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV-Echo: Echocardiogram Matched Subset, version 1.0.1
datasets.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (data use agreement, credentialing and training required)
datasets.format: echocardiogram video matched to MIMIC-IV stays
constrains: length_width, velocity_half, compression_coef, passive_stiffness: measured strain and ejection fraction in ICU patients
datasets.verdict: NOT_USABLE_HERE: credentialing required, not obtained in this job

negative_result.claim_H2: No public beat-resolved dataset with simultaneously recorded coronary flow or coronary/coronary-sinus pressure together with ventricular force and an electrical trace was found.
search_performed: full PhysioNet open-database index (437 projects) scanned for coronary, perfusion, FFR, iFR, pressure-flow, optical mapping, strain, impedance, synchronised
PhysioNet metadata pages fetched and licence/size/format parsed for the 10 entries above
negative_result.consequence_for_the_model: gregg_gain, hypoxia_penalty, perfusion_gamma, flow_max, p_ext and compression_coef stay anchored on published single-study contrasts (Schouten 1992, Schulz 1991, Goto 1991) and cannot be identified from public data. Do not present them as data-constrained.
negative_result.honest_labels: A systemic arterial pressure waveform is NOT coronary flow. A Pleth waveform is NOT coronary flow. Right heart catheter pressures are NOT coronary perfusion. None of these was counted as a coronary measurement.

recommended_order_of_use: 1. MIMIC-IV Waveform (rank 2) for the electrical-to-mechanical lag and afterload, with a FLAC-capable reader
2. HeartCycle (rank 4) for strain and systolic time intervals
3. SensSmartTech (rank 6) for heart-rate dependence of the drive and the force-velocity term
4. PTB-XL (rank 1) for population QRS and RR statistics at 3.0 GB scale, once the sample bound is lifted
